normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter is only meaningful as the source account processed by _transfer
The to parameter is only meaningful as the destination account processed by _transfer
The amount parameter is consumed solely by the _transfer value computation
The recipient parameter is forwarded into _transfer by the public transfer wrapper
The sender parameter is consumed by transferFrom's allowance and transfer logic
The spender parameter is written into _allowances by approve
The tokenAmount parameter determines the router swap performed by swapTokensForEth
The bots_ array is iterated and recorded by setBots
The notbot parameter is the only address cleared by delBot
The maxTxPercent parameter is converted into _maxTxAmount by setMaxTxPercent
The addr1 parameter is assigned to the privileged _marketingFunds field at construction
The tAmount parameter is the seed of the reflection arithmetic in _transferStandard
The onoff parameter is the sole assignment performed by setCooldownEnabled
The local balance is computed and immediately used in the swap branch of _transfer
The local ETH balance is computed and used for the fee send inside _transfer
The takeFee flag is derived inside _transfer and passed to _tokenTransfer
The currentRate local is the sole return value produced by _getRate
The path array is constructed solely for the swap performed by swapTokensForEth
The locally instantiated router is used only within openTrading setup
The cached caller local is used only for the ownership assignment in the constructor
The rAmount local is produced and consumed inside _transferStandard
The local balance is computed solely to feed the swap in manualswap
